title: Allocations familiales, household with 1 child: amount regime (second coder)

source.entry_point: InterfaceAllocationsFamiliales (Python: generated.Allocations_familiales.interface_allocations_familiales); components read from scope AllocationsFamiliales

attributes.name: residence
attributes.source: prologue_france/France.catala_fr:9-18 (Collectivité); L751-1 securite_sociale_L.catala_fr:376-385; smic/Smic.catala_fr:81-112 (SMIC 2020: Mayotte apart); Mayotte rules decrets_divers.catala_fr:181-238, 286-569. metropole = {Métropole, SaintPierreEtMiquelon}; drom_l751_1 = {Guadeloupe, Guyane, Martinique, LaRéunion, SaintBarthélemy, SaintMartin}; mayotte = {Mayotte}

attributes.name: ressources
attributes.source: ressources_ménage (EUR/year) relative to plafond_I_d521_3 = 57759 + 5775 n and plafond_II_d521_3 = 80831 + 5775 n at 2020 (decrets_divers.catala_fr:102-123), n = enfants with droit ouvert; tiers D521-1 securite_sociale_D.catala_fr:35, 76-78, 120; zones of the complément dégressif securite_sociale_D.catala_fr:169-185 and 277-308: zone_degressive_X = (plafond_X, plafond_X + 12 a], a = max(montant_versé_base + montant_versé_majoration, montant_versé_forfaitaire). plafond_* in a representative is the value the encoding computes for the household

attributes.name: avant_2012
attributes.source: avait_enfant_à_charge_avant_1er_janvier_2012, read only for Mayotte, decrets_divers.catala_fr:295-407 (décret 2002-423 annexe)

attributes.name: e1_age
attributes.source: date_de_naissance, banded at date_courante 2020-05-01 by every comparison the code makes: +3 an >= (epilogue.catala_fr:123, L131-1), +11 an <= (securite_sociale_D.catala_fr:419, D755-5), +14 an <= (securite_sociale_R.catala_fr:54 with securite_sociale_L.catala_fr:319, R521-1/L521-3), +16 an >= (epilogue.catala_fr:127) and +16 an > / <= (securite_sociale_D.catala_fr:420, 431), (+20 an) - date < 365 jour (securite_sociale_L.catala_fr:149-151, L521-1), +20 an > (securite_sociale_L.catala_fr:71, R512-2 securite_sociale_R.catala_fr:21), +11 an <= 2008-04-30 (securite_sociale_R.catala_fr:81). Representative = birth date

attributes.name: e1_remuneration
attributes.source: rémuneration_mensuelle (EUR/month) cut at the two values of plafond_l512_3_2 at 2020-05-01: 711.49 (Mayotte) and 943.02 (all others) = (smic.brut_horaire * 55%) * 169 (R512-2 securite_sociale_R.catala_fr:29-31, R755-0-2 securite_sociale_R.catala_fr:218-223, smic/Smic.catala_fr:81-112), compared with <= in L512-3 securite_sociale_L.catala_fr:70 and 83. Bands: [0, 711.49], (711.49, 943.02], (943.02, +inf)

attributes.name: e1_prise_en_charge
attributes.source: PriseEnCharge prologue.catala_fr:10-15, grouped by prise_en_compte (L521-2 securite_sociale_L.catala_fr:188-197, 209-231, 262-281): complete = {EffectiveEtPermanente, GardeAlternéeAllocataireUnique, ServicesSociauxAllocationVerséeÀLaFamille} (Complète), partagee = {GardeAlternéePartageAllocations} (Partagée), services_sociaux = {ServicesSociauxAllocationVerséeAuxServicesSociaux} (Zéro)

attributes.name: e1_deja_ouvert
attributes.source: a_déjà_ouvert_droit_aux_allocations_familiales, read only by the forfaitaire, L521-1 securite_sociale_L.catala_fr:153

output.name: regime_montant
output.source: regime of montant_versé (epilogue.catala_fr:45-52), read from the components the encoding computes: 'sans_droit' when droit_ouvert_base is false (L521-1 securite_sociale_L.catala_fr:124-127, L755-12 :436-442, Mayotte decrets_divers.catala_fr:191-194); otherwise bareme/tier/parts with bareme general (D521-1), outre_mer_un_enfant (D755-5 securite_sociale_D.catala_fr:384-433, no tier), mayotte or mayotte_avant_2012 (decrets_divers.catala_fr:181-407); tier T1/T2/T3 = ressources vs plafond_I/II (D521-1, D521-2); parts = non-zero components among B base, M majorations, F forfaitaire, C complément dégressif (base or forfaitaire), or 'nul'

exclusions.description: the person in charge is neither a parent nor a person meeting Title I: outside the domain the encoding asserts

date_courante.why: date of the PrestationsFamiliales test and of 7 of the 14 household tests; all date-dependent parameters (BMAF Bmaf.catala_fr:52-58, SMIC Smic.catala_fr:81-112, plafonds decrets_divers.catala_fr:102-123, Mayotte 2020 rates decrets_divers.catala_fr:389-398, 481-487, 562-568) are constant on 2020-04-01..2020-12-31

nombre_enfants.why: this sub-table holds households with exactly 1 child(ren) in i_enfants

d_identifiant.why: only used to tell apart children with equal birth dates (EnfantLePlusÂgé)

notes: Second, blinded conversion (see ../README-FR-CODE2.md). Sub-table of the household allowance split by number of children. Interpretive choices with sources are in CONVERSION_2.md.
